Name: LaurellaBellaBean Cabin Retex for 1.4
Author: LaurellaBellaBean
Description:
[u][font=Verdana][color=#bf9000][size=2]Install Instructions[/size][/color][/font][/u]
[font=Times New Roman]
There are two versions of this mod. One version requires Content Patcher and SMAPI and requires a simple drag and drop of my mod into your Mods folder. Download Content Patcher [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]HERE[/url] and SMAPI [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]HERE.  [/url]Content Patcher goes in your Content folder, as well. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]

[/url]The other version is a simple replacer of the vanilla cabins and are XNB files. Drag and drop these into your Content/Buildings folder. ﻿You may want to copy the vanilla files and put them on your desktop (or wherever) so you can revert back to vanilla if you want to. 

My game is through GOG Galaxy, so for me, the game's file path is C:/GOG Galaxy/Games/Stardew Valley. Inside the Stardew Valley folder is where you will find the Mods folder and the Content folder. If you use Steam for this game, the file path for the game is C:/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley. Again, inside the [/font][font=Times New Roman]Stardew Valley folder is where you will find the Mods folder and the Content folder.[/font][font=Times New Roman]

Enjoy!

Credits: Eemie Stardew for the wisteria texture, and muh internet for being muh internet and giving me RPG Maker images. Also, credit to RPG Maker sprite authors.

[/font]
